title: MUSCLE MANGA - Lu Bu's Physique in Record of Ragnarok
summary: NH analyses Lu Bu, humanity's first champion in Record of Ragnarok: his physique (V-taper, chest, serratus, deep lat insertions, freaky upper back), how combat swings could have built it, his lifelong hunger for a worthy opponent, and his fatal fight against Thor. He frames the character's joy as found in fighting against overwhelming odds.
claims: Record of Ragnarok is an inspiring, anabolic manga that focuses on larger-than-life characters
Lu Bu's V-taper comes from a very developed chest and serratus with deep lat insertions
Swinging a halberd up and down mimics a lat pulldown, and slicing left and right mimics standing Russian twists that build the core
Lu Bu shows the muscular density only a lifetime of physical exertion can pack on: thick upper back, huge delts, vascular arms
Having no one left to challenge was agony for Lu Bu; his thirst was for adversity, not victory
When you set high standards, those who admire you will hold you accountable if you falter
True joy is found rushing toward victory when the odds are stacked against you, not in crushing weaker enemies
A leader with enough charisma and strength earns loyalty even in failure, as Lu Bu's army followed him into death
